3.title: About Mersal
3.desc: Mersal is a non-profit healthcare charity that provides high-quality medical care of every kind to anyone in need, and works to spread health awareness across Egypt.

4.title: Mersal Oncology Center
4.desc: Mersal's center for cancer diagnosis and treatment offers screening and follow-up, chemotherapy, and supports surgery, radiotherapy and transplants for patients who can't afford them.

5.title: About the Center
5.desc: Mersal Oncology Center opened in July 2016, offering screening, follow-up and chemotherapy, and supporting surgical and radiotherapy interventions.

6.title: Our Doctors
6.desc: The doctors of Mersal Oncology Center.

7.title: Clinic Hours
7.desc: Clinic hours at Mersal Oncology Center.

17.title: Mersal Medical Convoys (Convoys of Joy)
17.desc: Mersal's medical convoys reach patients where they live, meeting their needs before they have to ask, in villages and underserved areas.

18.title: Mersal Emergency Team
18.desc: Mersal aims to be the first responder for every patient, providing urgent medical services around the clock through its emergency project.

19.title: Hekayet Sout (A Voice Story)
19.desc: The Hekayet Sout project supports cochlear implant surgery, speech therapy and behavioural therapy for children with hearing loss.

20.title: PKU Project
20.desc: PKU is a rare inherited metabolic disease that is detected in the first weeks after birth and needs a lifelong special diet. Mersal helps families afford it.

26.title: Mersal Volunteers
26.desc: The Mersal volunteers project brings in volunteers from every field to help serve patients. Volunteers are trained inside the foundation.

27.title: Guest House for Patients
27.desc: A free place to stay for patients receiving treatment in Cairo who have nowhere to stay and can't afford accommodation.

29.title: Afia Card
29.desc: The Afia card gives its holder and family discounts on all medical services through a wide network of providers, with discounts of up to 70%.

30.title: Mersal Children's Hospital
30.desc: To support the health sector and every person's right to complete healthcare, we are completing the dream: a 5,000 m² children's hospital for critical cases.

31.title: Mersal Oncology Center
31.desc: Mersal's center for cancer diagnosis and treatment offers screening and follow-up, chemotherapy, and supports surgery, radiotherapy and transplants.

32.title: Mersal Guest House
32.desc: The Mersal Guest House offers free accommodation in Cairo for patients from other governorates who can't travel daily or afford a place to stay during treatment.

33.title: Hekayet Sout Project
33.desc: Sometimes the cure is simple and only needs support. That is the case for many people with hearing loss whose hearing can be restored or improved.

34.title: PKU Treatment Project
34.desc: PKU is a metabolic disease detected in the first weeks of a baby's life. Its treatment is costly, so Mersal helps families provide it.

35.title: Mersal Convoys
35.desc: Mersal works with healthcare providers to bring integrated services to patients; our convoys team serves villages and underserved areas.

36.title: Psychological Support Project
36.desc: Mersal believes in integrated care for patients and their families, so it provides psychological support sessions for registered patients.

37.title: Monthly Treatment Program
37.desc: Patients with chronic illnesses struggle with the high cost of medicines they need every month, so Mersal steps in with monthly treatment.

38.title: Medical Exams & Tests
38.desc: Mersal provides medical check-ups for patients who can't afford them, to diagnose illness or for the regular tests some patients need.

39.title: Surgeries
39.desc: Some illnesses can only be treated with surgery, to save the patient's life, prevent complications or end their pain. Mersal covers surgery costs.

40.title: Paying Off Patients' Debts
40.desc: The cost of care can leave patients unable to pay their medical bills. Mersal pays off treatment debts for patients who are struggling.

41.title: Medical Supplies
41.desc: Patients with physical disabilities may lack the assistive devices they need to live their lives. Mersal provides medical devices and supplies.

42.title: Patient Family Sponsorship
42.desc: Mersal aims to provide complete care and improve lives, so its sponsorship project gives monthly support to the families of patients.

43.title: Mersal Clinics
43.desc: Mersal Clinics provide high-quality medical care to patients who can and cannot afford it, across more than 15 specialties.

44.title: Mersal Academy
44.desc: Mersal Academy runs educational programmes in management and business administration, training people in the scientific methods of leading business schools.

45.title: Mersal Store
45.desc: Mersal Store is one of the foundation's projects: its profits help treat patients, as a sustainable source of income for our services.

46.title: Our Branches
46.desc: Addresses of Mersal's branches, including New Maadi (8 Street 263) and Nasr City.

47.title: Mersal Volunteers
47.desc: Mersal offers volunteering opportunities that help volunteers build their personal skills and knowledge while serving patients.

48.title: Ways to Give to Mersal
48.desc: Request a home collection on 19340 or 01200002870, pay through Fawry with code 9200, or use wallets, bank transfers and more.

51.title: Frequently Asked Questions
51.desc: What is Mersal Foundation? Mersal is a healthcare charity in Egypt that works to reach every patient in need and provide all their needs.

52.title: Critical Care Center for Newborns
52.desc: Mersal's incubators project began when Mersal provided 12 fully equipped incubators with a medical team of consultants for families who couldn't afford care.

54.title: The First Rare Diseases Forum
54.desc: The Rare Diseases Forum: towards more inclusive and equitable healthcare. Mersal Foundation organised its conference under this title.
